}}'''Gallanha''' is the wife of [[Thulin]] and mother of [[Mirala]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Gallanha}}

==Apperance==
Gallanha has golden hair.

==History==
Originally from somewhere in the south, she moved to the [[Borderlands]] to be with her husband in the village of Oak Water.

==Activities==
When her husband sees the unnatural storm, he decides to pack up his family and travel to help with the war in the north. On their way, they visit [[Renald Fanwar]] and Gallanha gives him some eggs to give to his wife, [[Auaine Fanwar|Auaine]].{{ref/book|12|p}}
